Hi all — great to meet you virtually, Rita. Confirming availability for Tue Nov 8 at 16:30 GMT. A couple of operational asks so the handoff is smooth given the DST flip in the US on Nov 7: 

1) Handoff buffer: Please build in a 25–30 minute overlap where Vivek kicks off with context, then stays on for initial Qs while I share my screen and take over. That avoids the 1-hour scheduling cliff when US times shift — it also gives the security contact time to ask SOC-2 questions without losing context.

2) Calendar invite: Vivek, please send an invite set to 16:30–18:00 GMT (90 minutes) but include an agenda that reserves the first 30 minutes for SDR context + intro (so Olga begins formally at :30). I find 90-minute invites with a clear agenda reduces last-minute confusion.

3) Explicit TZ labels: In the invite and descriptions use both local and absolute times (e.g., 08:30 PT / 11:30 ET / 16:30 GMT). Avoid ambiguous labels like "local" or "same as scheduled."

4) Recording & Slides: We'll record and drop the deck in the Drive link; tag the recording with the HubSpot deal id so CS can triage any follow-ups.

I've attached a short screenshot table showing post-DST offsets and a suggested meeting agenda. Marissa — can you own the calendar invite and include the security contact rachel.infosec@acmehealth.com?

—Olga
